Game Overview

In Hollow Fly, the core idea is straightforward: navigate haunting labyrinths and dodge menacing foes in Hollow Fly. Collect keys to unlock eerie levels, wielding a powerful sonar beam to fend off relentless enemies. Strategically use vibrant power-ups to boost speed, firepower, and health, but beware - each loss comes with a price.
